autospam.title: Autospam
autospam.subtitle: The automated spam detection system

about.title: About Autospam
about.intro: To detect and mitigate spam, we built Autospam, an internal tool that uses NLP and other behavioural metrics to classify potential spam posts.
about.standardBody: Standard or "Classic" detection works by evaluating several "signals" from the post and it's associated account.
about.signalsIntro: Some of the following "signals" may trigger a positive detection from public posts:
about.signalAge: Account is less than 6 months old
about.signalLinks: Post contains one or more of:
about.notSpamSkip: If you've marked atleast one positive detection from an account as {notSpam}, any future posts they create will skip detection.
about.advancedBody1: Advanced Detection works by using a statistical method that combines prior knowledge and observed data to estimate an average value. It assigns weights to both the prior knowledge and the observed data, allowing for a more informed and reliable estimation that adapts to new information.
about.advancedBody2: When you train Spam or Not Spam data, the caption is broken up into words (tokens) and are counted (weights) and then stored in the appropriate category (Spam or Not Spam).
about.advancedBody3: The training data is then used to classify spam on future posts (captions) by calculating each token and associated weights and comparing it to known categories (Spam or Not Spam).

train.intro: In order for Autospam to be effective, you need to train it by classifying data as spam or not-spam.
train.recommend: We recommend atleast 200 classifications for both spam and not-spam, it is important to train Autospam on both so you get more accurate results.
train.spamPostsHelp: Use existing posts marked as spam to train Autospam
train.nonSpamPostsHelp: Use posts from trusted users to train non-spam posts
train.selectTrusted: Select trusted accounts to train non-spam posts against!
train.submitTrusted: Train non-spam posts on trusted accounts

tokens.intro: Tokens are used to split paragraphs and sentences into smaller units that can be more easily assigned meaning.

importExport.intro: You can import and export Spam training data
importExport.caution: We recommend exercising caution when importing training data from untrusted parties!
importExport.importHelp: Make sure the file you are importing is a valid training data export!
importExport.exportHelp: Only share training data with people you trust. It can be used by spammers to bypass detection!

apr2022.darkModeHelp: To enable dark or light mode, click on the top nav menu and then select UI Settings

mar2022.fullScreenPreviews: Full screen previews on photo albums
mar2022.filterNotifications: Filter notifications by type on notifications tab
mar2022.sharedByLink: Add "Shared by" link to posts that opens a list of accounts that reblogged the post
mar2022.privateFeedFix: Fix private profile feed not loading for owner

feb2022.discoverLayout: New Discover layout with My Hashtags, My Memories, Account Insights, Find Friends and Server Timelines
feb2022.profileLayoutSetting: Add Preferred Profile Layout UI setting
feb2022.mobileSearch: Add search bar to mobile breakpoints and adjust avatar size when necessary
feb2022.mobileProfileLayout: Improved profile layout on mobile breakpoints
feb2022.mediaPreviewDefault: Changed default media preview setting to non-fixed height media
feb2022.locationSearch: Improved Compose Location search, will display popular locations first
feb2022.commentButton: Added "Comment" button to comment reply form and changed textarea/multiline icon toggle
feb2022.avatarFix: Fixed incorrect avatar in profile post comment drawers
feb2022.remoteHashtags: Hashtags will now include remote/federated posts on hashtag feeds
feb2022.mediaLicense: Moved media license to post header
feb2022.mediaPreviews: Improved Media Previews - disable to restore original preview aspect ratios
feb2022.commentHovercards: Comments + Hovercards - comment usernames now support hovercards
feb2022.quickAvatar: Quick Avatar Updates - click the {icon} button on your avatar. Supports drag-n-drop and updates without page refresh in most places.
feb2022.followsYouBadge: Follows You badge on hovercards when applicable
feb2022.nsfwVideoFix: Fix nsfw videos not displaying sensitive warning
feb2022.modTools: Added mod tools button to posts for admin accounts

jan2022.reactionBar: New Reaction bar on posts - to disable toggle this option in UI Settings menu
jan2022.fresherComments: Fresher Comments - fixed bug that prevented new comments from appearing and added a Refresh button to do it manually in the event it's needed
jan2022.commentAutoload: Added Comment Autoloading setting, enabled by default, it loads the first 3 comments
jan2022.likesFeed: Added Likes feed to your own profile to view posts you liked
jan2022.emojiFix: Fixed custom emoji rendering on sidebar, profiles and hover cards
jan2022.onboardingFeed: New onboarding home feed with 6 popular accounts to help newcomers find accounts to follow
jan2022.emojiTimelineFix: Fixed custom emoji rendering on home timeline
jan2022.hovercards: Added Hovercards to usernames on timelines
jan2022.searchBar: Improved search bar, now resolves (and imports) remote accounts and posts, including webfinger addresses
jan2022.fullUsernames: Added full account usernames to notifications on hover
jan2022.discoverDefault: Discover page will default to the Yearly tab if Daily tab is empty
jan2022.hashtagFeed: Hashtag feed improvements (fix pagination placeholders, use 4x4 grid on larger screens)
jan2022.reportModal: New report modal for posts & comments
